rules: Record the complete expanded argv and QEMU version in every Step-40 evidence bundle.
Preferred VirtIO-MMIO transport becomes accepted only after Step-33/34 runtime proof; otherwise use the explicit PCI fallback.
ROOT_OVERLAY must be created from the verified pinned Debian base; never boot Step-40 acceptance with writes directed to the pinned base image.
SMP must include the accepted final matrix selected by the Step-40 integrator; at minimum preserve the existing 1/2/4-vCPU regression coverage where practical.
Do not silently add unrelated devices to make Debian boot; each added device becomes part of the documented product profile and owner matrix.
